description:
[Start here] Search everything: items, skins, monuments, NPCs, vehicles, commands, settings, guides, servers. One search box over the whole network. Each result: `type` (page, item, skin, monument, creature, vehicle,
command, convar, concept, glossary, blog, server), `title`, `summary`, `key`, `url`, and `next` - the tool (and
its arguments) to call for the full record. Grouped by type, best match first within each; the same item/skin/
monument matching as the site's search box. Cached for five minutes per query. One search over items, skins, monuments, animals/NPCs, vehicles, console commands, server settings, concept guides, glossary terms, blog guides and servers. Each result's `next` names the tool and arguments to call.

q.description: What to look for: a name, a term, a question keyword (`ak`, `oil rig`, `bear`, `minicopter`, `decay`, `honeycomb`).

types.description: Only these result types (repeatable). Default: all.
